evidence:
Scope and authority: independently inspected the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl. 'Quality Checks'!A49:D49 contains check 48, dimension_prompts_are_accurate_and_consistent: 'Every dimension prompt describes THIS app (credentials, screens, entities, deliverable) with no residue from other work. Reports every instance.' 'Internal Quality Checks' row 49 has the same description. Applied the frozen skill and quality-checks.md:191-192, the staged contract's prompt/app_context and judge configuration sections, deterministic-checks.md's rubric-prompt, batched-independence, runtime-strings and demo-accounts sections, and current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md. This is a dedicated row review, not a complete QC clearance.

Identity, credentials and entities agree across every prompt and its injected criteria. Frozen task task.toml:5-6 names turing/colderwater-playground-devtools and a local JS/HTML/CSS playground. instruction.md:1 explicitly says 'No accounts or sign-in'; environment/instructions/overview.md:7 and policy.md:3 specify the shared library. tests/app_context.md:3-12 describes Colderwater Playground at http://localhost:3000, 'There is no sign-in', and the editor/preview/console, title/filename, Run/Stop/Auto-run/Clear, examples/library/New/Save/theme surfaces. Both gate prompts:1 and the Polish/Visual prompts:1 identify Colderwater; Functional prompt:1 takes the same URL and inherits the name/context at line 3. Render:14, Constraints:15, Functional:19, Polish:21 and Visual:33 consistently reject sign-in/account assumptions. No foreign product, account list, credential requirement or entity shape was found.

Inspected all five prompt.md files in full and all five injected judge.toml files, not only their headings. Public semantics in behaviour.md:5-29 and security.md:3-11 agree with app_context.md:16-24 and Functional's complete S01-S36 protocols: case-insensitive filename dispatch, fresh execution/CSS copy, supported callbacks sharing five seconds, last-good rollback, later interaction/Stop, source-relative error lines, console/history, Auto-run, exact saved fields, revisions and title rules. The public freedom to choose labels/layout/API routes in policy.md:5 is preserved by Functional:7,13,19,348; Constraints:25-33; Polish:24-30,43-49; and Visual:35-43. Visual judges playground chrome, not arbitrary authored output (Visual:37), consistent with ui.md:9. No required import, export, delete, separate Rename feature, technology-specific DOM or exact example name is introduced.

Configuration and insertion are consistent. Every judge.toml selects prompt.md; each source prompt has exactly one {app_context} and one {criteria}. test.sh:198-200 inserts the context into all five prompts. task.toml:31-35 uses the frozen claude-code / z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx provider selection; prompts make no contradictory model claim. Functional judge.toml:4 declares timeout 9000, matching Functional prompt:113. A read-only TOML/protocol inventory found 23 named Functional protocols, matching Functional prompt:9, and 58 Functional, 7 Polish, 6 Visual, 1 Render and 1 Constraints criteria. Visual prompt:17 refers to the first five desktop criteria and the sixth responsive criterion; the six actual Visual criterion blocks agree. Functional judge.toml:14-18 alone provides restart_app, matching Functional prompt:23,359-369. test.sh:213-227 runs gates before the scored suite as all scored prompts describe. The logical task slug is taken from the manifest/task configuration, not the snapshot directory named task.

Evidence-failure and independent-credit wording agrees across prompts. app_context.md:28 says 'distinguish a tool failure from a product failure', 'Return supported outcomes for the remaining criteria', and explicitly does not guarantee recovery from a whole judge-process timeout. Functional:5,9-11,21-25,98-113 distinguishes ordinary app defects from unavailable setup, preserves sibling observations, prohibits invented passes and uses one restart. Polish:34-39 and Visual:46-51 apply the same distinction. Render/Constraints inherit the same shared guidance and require positive Run/save evidence rather than assuming a pass from a static screen. The gate criteria say turn Auto-run off, but the explicit shared correction app_context.md:16 says to do so only if available and assigns a missing Auto-run control to its owner; this is not a conflicting unconditional gate requirement. A missing observation remains unmeasured; source consistency does not establish configured judge completion.

Adversarial manual traces: a conforming implementation with a server-rendered library, a drawer and native keyboard navigation, different API field names, proactive stale-Save prevention, no Restore button and hidden provisional preview is explicitly accepted by Constraints:27,33; Polish:43-49; Functional:17,19,21,377-380; and Visual:37. A partly broken app that refuses a stale save correctly but loses the dirty draft keeps separate server-refusal evidence (Functional judge.toml:365 versus :372; prompt:100,375-379). A static seeded library or localStorage-only save cannot pass Constraints judge.toml:25-29; a dead Auto-run or never-fired timer cannot earn suppression credit (Functional:169,336 and judge.toml:295,302). These attempts found no surviving false-fail/false-pass witness caused by cross-task residue or inconsistent dimension descriptions. They are source traces, not executed alternative app judge runs.

Source/log binding verified read-only: all 15 reviewed core/task prompt-and-judge paths checked against manifest.json matched the frozen task input; all actual_app_files recorded by the golden RESULTS.json matched solution/app bytes. Reviewed relevant raw facts directly in golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json: facts.S01.startup_ready.evidence.value records actual hello.js source, a rendered 1-through-12 squared preview, 'printed %d rows' console feedback and manual_run_used=false; facts.S07.snippet_network_boundary.evidence records successful local text/image controls (image width 2, baseline deliveries 2), separate fetch/image refusal observations with deliveries staying 2, and recovery; facts.S23 records identity 5, first winner revision 2, retained three-field dirty draft and recovery revision 3, then reversed winner revision 4 and recovery revision 5. The S07 driver was checked at drivers/boundary_flow.cjs:24-35 and S23 at drivers/library_flow.cjs:52-79; hashes of the inspected boundary/library/workspace/run workflow drivers match RESULTS.json. These observations corroborate the stated product identity and data flows but do not execute all dimension prompts through the configured LLM judge. RESULTS.json explicitly records paid_provider=false, browser_driver='direct pinned Playwright', oracle_score_claimed=false. Full judge timing, Oracle and target-builder scores remain unmeasured and are not claimed by this Pass.
